name: Commercial Bank
description: Banks that accept deposits and provide loans and other banking services.

name: Public Sector Bank
description: Banks where the government holds the majority ownership.

name: Private Sector Bank
description: Banks primarily owned by private shareholders and corporations.

name: Foreign Bank
description: Banks headquartered outside India that operate in India.

name: Regional Rural Bank
description: Banks focused on providing banking and credit services to rural and agricultural sectors.

name: Co-operative Bank
description: Banks operating on a cooperative basis to serve members and local communities.

name: Urban Co-operative Bank
description: Co-operative banks primarily serving urban and semi-urban areas.

name: State Co-operative Bank
description: Co-operative banks operating at the state level.

name: Payments Bank
description: Banks focused on deposits, payments and remittance services with restrictions on lending.

name: Small Finance Bank
description: Banks focused on financial inclusion and serving underserved sections of the economy.

name: Development Bank
description: Specialized financial institutions providing long-term financing for development activities.

name: Central Bank
description: The supreme monetary authority responsible for monetary policy and regulation of the banking system.
